proposed.explanation: Arts and Crafts rejected historical revival; its forward-thinking principles opposed historicism. Arts and Crafts explicitly rejected industrial mass production, not prioritized it. Arts and Crafts rejected applied ornament in favor of honest expression of materials and function. The Arts and Crafts movement, led by William Morris and C.F.A. Voysey, unified around principles of honest materials and elimination of false ornament—principles that enabled modernism despite the movement's preference for handcraft over industrial production.
